ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A dead teaching is a fixed formulation applied without the live responsiveness the records demand. Masters use the verdict for inherited understanding, formulaic words, and even a stick or phrase when someone clings to it as a settled way to receive people.
EvidenceBody: Juelang Daosheng condemns teachers who receive people with dead words and dead teaching, comparing it to forcing an ox’s head down to eat grass.
The Treatise on Tempering Chan says people cling to dead teaching and will not extend a hand at the precipice, even when they possess ability.
Tianru Weize says even an understanding that agrees with buddhas and patriarchs remains dead teaching when it lacks “living intent”; the text itself supplies the dead/live contrast.

Guxue Zhe says that clinging to a single use of the stick would itself become dead teaching, then lists his differing responses to different people. The headword therefore marks fixation, not a permanent class of forbidden words.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: The records turn “dead” into an explicit verdict on teachings and responses treated as fixed, opposing them to living intent or a living road.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: No word, stick, or inherited statement is dead by lexical identity alone; the cited masters apply the verdict to fixed handling.

ComparedThings: A fixed explanation, inherited device, or stick can each receive the verdict ‘dead teaching’; the judged vehicle changes, but the verdict consistently names lifelessly fixed handling
DifferentThingTest.Reason: A fixed explanation, inherited device, or stick can each receive the verdict ‘dead teaching’; the judged vehicle changes, but the verdict consistently names lifelessly fixed handling.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Dead teaching, dead rule, dead formulation, fixed words, and dead way of teaching track the explicit 死語/死法 and 活意/活路 contrasts.

ModifierControls.reason: 生死法 is a false substring family and was excluded: there 死 joins 生 as ‘birth-and-death,’ whereas 死 in 死法 directly modifies teaching as dead.

FamilyControls.reason: 死語 is the paired dead-word label; 活意 and 活路 are the texts’ positive contrasts. They explain the verdict but remain distinct headwords.
